# Real buyer-owned CSV structural quality check (original VM5 hosted merchant, ONE beneficial human owner)
Original same-owner real CSV buyer-input x402 route (POST, 0.005 Base Circle USDC):
https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-preflight
Request content-type application/json, body fields csvText:string required, expectedColumns:string[] optional. A valid unauthenticated synthetic-only POST receives HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED (not a paid call). Invalid/empty CSV receives HTTP 400 with no 402 challenge. Supports up to 32 KiB UTF-8 CSV, 500 data rows and 40 columns. Paid result is a bounded structural anomaly report; not a certified privacy/security audit. Do not send personal, secret or customer data without authorization.
Free 200 JSON original fake-example/demo + exact schema and limits: https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-sample
Separately, GET https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/v1/csv-report costs the same but processes a STATIC SYNTHETIC sample, not the buyer's CSV. Do not confuse it with POST buyer data.
VM3 owned accurate public usage / payment-handshake guide: https://livastic-vm3-primary-tmp-260920.github.io/defi-payment-proof-qa/guides/csv-structural-preflight-005-base-usdc.html
Canonical machine-readable OpenAPI provider spec: https://vm5-openapi-x402.onrender.com/openapi.json
This is the original same-owner VM5 merchant receiving route, not a new VM3 wallet/merchant, and not a guaranteed customer or previously verified distinct paid POST order. Buyer provides their own authorization and settled USDC; no sale is recorded from free samples or HTTP402. No owner-funded testing, selfpayment, gas, escrow bond, invented security guarantees or identity claims.

- Transfer pair free tool https://livastic-vm3-primary-tmp-260920.github.io/defi-payment-proof-qa/guides/crypto-transfer-csv-pair-auditor.html now explicitly recognizes official Kraken ledger headers txid/refid/time/type/subtype/aclass/asset/amount/fee/balance, UTC time, negative withdraw/positive deposit. ## ORIGINAL VM3 free x402 browser CORS doctor (2026-10-20)
Public browser link: https://livastic-vm3-primary-tmp-260920.github.io/defi-payment-proof-qa/guides/x402-browser-cors-doctor.html
Original pure local source: https://github.com/livastic-vm3-primary-tmp-260920/defi-payment-proof-qa/blob/main/x402-cors-doctor-local.mjs
Built for documented x402 HTTP 402 CORS browser-readability/preflight issues (x402 Foundation issue #3722). One buyer-authorized public GET (no payment header/signature/credentials/wallet; no auto requests) checks whether an actual browser sees unpaid HTTP402's PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Offline user-pasted 402 and OPTIONS HTTP header transcripts are parsed locally to identify missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Expose-Headers for PAYMENT-REQUIRED/PAYMENT-RESPONSE, bad OPTIONS code or absent PAYMENT-SIGNATURE/Content-Type allow lists; no transcript means unknown, never a positive payment claim. Field reference from original same-beneficial-owner public VM5 0.005 USDC x402 merchant is a correctly readable 402/OPTIONS204 only, not a transaction or paid buyer. No contract, quote acceptance, wallet settlement or money claimed.
Optional separate human client asks for a scoped CORS/402 report using the original single-owner email mailto:onecursor1@gmail.com; existing Soul.Markets 0.75/1.50 USDC schemas analyze unsigned public quote shapes but do not test browser CORS or signed delivery. Real buyer feedback survey: https://livastic-vm3-primary-tmp-260920.github.io/defi-payment-proof-qa/guides/base-usdc-merchant-ledger.html#buyer-feedback . No automatic mass outreach, tracking or signer.
